# m1_data contract

- Layer: L0 data and content. Schema versions produced: gold.v1, transcript.v1, manifest.v1.
- Inputs: fetched public sources (cited in `data/lexicon/drugs.csv` and
  `data/templates/SOURCES.md`), `.claude/skills/kannada-nlp/negation_table.yaml` (read for
  self-check and coverage only).
- May import: `contracts.validate` only (tests). No other module's code.

## Outputs (all under `data/`, regenerated by `make data`)

| path | format | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `lexicon/drugs.csv` | CSV, columns exactly as AGENT 2 step 1 | 34 drugs (18 antibiotics). `source_url` = pipe-separated fetched URLs; blank dose = UNVERIFIED |
| `templates/*.yaml`, `templates/_forms.yaml`, `templates/SOURCES.md` | YAML / md | 59 templates, 9 categories, 22 families |
| `gold/<cid>.json` | gold.v1 | `cid` = `m1-<template>-<nnn>`; `template_family_id` = `<category>_<name>__f<n>` |
| `gold_v2/<cid>.json` | gold.v2 | same content as `gold/` plus route, strength, formulation, as_needed, food_timing, status, speaker, age band, each with an evidence span; derived from template metadata (data/templates/README.md). Test files are APPENDED to `test.lock` under their own comment |
| `transcripts/gold/<cid>__gold.json` | transcript.v1 | model `{name: gold, revision: <generator version>}`, source `template_text`, text = turns joined by `\n` |
| `twins/twins_{dev,test}.jsonl` | JSON lines (m1-defined, below) | minimal pairs, one per negated cue slot |
| `splits/dev.txt`, `splits/test.txt` | one conversation id per line | split membership |
| `splits/split_plan.json` | JSON | families and dosed drug-dose combinations per split |
| `splits/test.lock` | `<sha256>  <path>` per line, `#` comments | format of `infra/scripts/check_split_lock.py` |
| `manifest.jsonl` | manifest.v1 | one row per gold, transcript and twins file |

Twin row fields: `twin_id, conversation_id, template_id, template_family_id, split,
turn_index, slot, primary_pattern, patterns[], cross_turn, previous_turn_text,
negated_text, twin_text, cue_text, positive_text, items[{kind, label, negated_original,
negated_twin, span_in ("turn"|"previous_turn"), negated_span[2], negated_span_text,
twin_span[2], twin_span_text}], generator_version, native_validated (false)`.

## Split rules (PROJECT_BRIEF 6.5)

- Template families and DOSED drug-dose combinations `(drug, value, unit)` are
  split-exclusive; bare drug mentions without a dose may occur in both splits.
- Every category (a)..(i) has families in both splits.
- Consumers use the DEV split only; only `make eval-test` reads test.
- `test.lock` covers every test gold file, test gold transcript, `twins_test.jsonl` and
  `test.txt`. The generator refuses to change it without `--refreeze`.
- Audio pass (later): each audio file gets a manifest row with `parent_id` = conversation
  id and the conversation's split; plan = TTS voice A in dev+test, voice B test-only
  (held out); new test files are APPENDED to the lock.

## Mock mode

`MODE=mock make m1-mock`: generator on `fixtures/lexicon/drugs_fixture.csv` only
(templates needing drugs the fixture lacks are skipped and counted), output to
`results/m1_data/mock/`.
